title: MEDRE typed exact-target delivery preview
description: Read-only observation of one persisted delivery selected by its exact (event, plan, adapter, channel) identity. Every field describes persisted state at observation time; none authorizes a replay, cancellation, or any other mutation. Attempt counters are the raw persisted finalized counter and reservation, never a display-normalized effective generation.

target_channel.description: The selected channel, or null for the deliberate no-channel identity. The empty string is never a valid channel decision.

attempt_number.description: Raw persisted finalized attempt counter, including zero for never-dispatched staged work.

active_attempt.description: Raw persisted in-flight attempt reservation, when a dispatch owner holds one.

observed_generation.description: Mirrors attempt_number exactly; never a display-normalized effective generation.

payload_hash.description: Persisted render-input binding for the selected row, when present.

snapshot_present.description: Whether a frozen dispatch snapshot row was observed for the selected outbox generation.

category.description: Closed observation category. This vocabulary is frozen across the Python Literal, this enum, and the specification table; it is an observation, never a mutation permit.

excluded_sibling_count.description: Outbox rows for the same event that the exact selection did not select; zero when no single row was selected.

cancel_eligible.description: Whether the selected row matches the exact-cancellation eligibility predicate (pending/retry_wait without a reservation or claim). An observation, not a permit.
